card.name: Words just before 'solution' or 'dissolved'
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs after a substance, where the next word is likely 'solution' or 'dissolved' (e.g. 'into solution', 'in the fluid'). Seen in drug reconstitution and chemistry text.

modes.label: Bringing powder into solution
modes.description: A preposition after a powder or drug in vial-mixing steps, where 'solution' or 'dissolved' comes next.
modes.example: Shake the reaction vial sufficiently to bring the lyophilized material<< into>> solution.

modes.label: Dissolving and staying dissolved
modes.description: Words after a solute that describe it dissolving or remaining in a liquid.
modes.example: Crystals will re<<-d>>issolve upon dilution during admixture

modes.label: Substances in water or fluid
modes.description: A preposition after a substance or organism, pointing to a liquid medium.
modes.example: The WQC were developed to protect organisms<< in>> the water column
